titulo: How Challenger Junglers End Games Fast - Jungle Macro in 5

descripcion:
Most players can win fights.

But they don’t know how to end the game.

In this episode of Macro in 5, we break down how Challenger junglers convert kills into waves, towers, and game-ending pressure.

Through real examples, you’ll learn:

• Why chasing kills slows your game down
• How to identify free waves and tower pressure
• When to skip camps and play the map
• How Challenger players turn one play into 2,000+ gold
• The real reason games drag on (even when you’re ahead)

The difference isn’t mechanics.

It’s how you see the map.

Waves. Towers. That’s how you end games.
